tasks.label: Build+Install+Run Monkeybrains (BikeSegments)
args: java -Xms1g -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -Dapple.awt.UIElement=true -jar "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Garmin/ConnectIQ/Sdks/connectiq-sdk-mac-9.1.0-2026-03-09-6a872a80b/bin/monkeybrains.jar" -o bin/BikeSegments.prg -f "$PWD/monkey.jungle" -y "$PWD/source/developer_key" -d edge1030plus -w && for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Garmin/ConnectIQ/Sdks/connectiq-sdk-mac-9.1.0-2026-03-09-6a872a80b/bin/monkeydo" bin/BikeSegments.prg edge1030plus && break || sleep 0.5; done

tasks.label: Build+Install+Run Monkeybrains (BikeSegments) (Debug)
args: open "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Garmin/ConnectIQ/Sdks/connectiq-sdk-mac-9.1.0-2026-03-09-6a872a80b/bin/ConnectIQ.app" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; backup="$PWD/resources/strings/strings.xml.bak"; cp "$PWD/resources/strings/strings.xml" "$backup"; trap "mv \"$backup\" \"$PWD/resources/strings/strings.xml\"" EXIT; cp "$PWD/resources/strings/strings.debug.xml" "$PWD/resources/strings/strings.xml" && java -Xms1g -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -Dapple.awt.UIElement=true -jar "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Garmin/ConnectIQ/Sdks/connectiq-sdk-mac-9.1.0-2026-03-09-6a872a80b/bin/monkeybrains.jar" -o bin/BikeSegments.prg -f "$PWD/monkey.jungle" -y "$PWD/source/developer_key" -d edge1030plus -w && for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Garmin/ConnectIQ/Sdks/connectiq-sdk-mac-9.1.0-2026-03-09-6a872a80b/bin/monkeydo" bin/BikeSegments.prg edge1030plus && break || sleep 0.5; done
